description: This file defines a Java interface DigitalProductDao that extends a generic DAO interface to perform database operations related to DigitalProduct entities. It includes a method to retrieve a DigitalProduct based on a MerchantStore and Product.

classes.name: DigitalProductDao
classes.description: A Java interface for data access operations related to DigitalProduct objects, extending a generic DAO interface.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Fetches a DigitalProduct entity based on the given MerchantStore and Product.
